data.long_meaning: The Greek name Barbra may be derived from the Greek word bárbaros, meaning 'foreigner' or 'barbarian'. It was also a common name for women in the Byzantine Empire. In the Bible, there is a city called Babylon, which could potentially influence the name's meaning. The name Barbra carries the meaning “Strong, foreign woman” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Barbra usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, foreign woman and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Barbra can be attributed to its connection to Babylon in the Bible.
